template.label: Artwork template
template.description: Choose how playlist artwork is generated: a collage of the playlist's album covers or artist images, or a cover generated with AI.

option_descriptions.album_grid: Album covers arranged in a grid.
option_descriptions.album_fan: Album covers stacked as framed photo cards, slightly rotated.
option_descriptions.album_grid_tilted: A grid with white gaps, tilted ~15°.
option_descriptions.artist_mosaic: The most-played artist large in the centre, others as smaller tiles.
option_descriptions.artist_grid: Up to four unique artist images in equal tiles.
option_descriptions.artist_radio: The main artist centred on a solid background with overlapping circles.
option_descriptions.artist_banner: The playlist name over a full-bleed artist image.
option_descriptions.ai_generated: A cover generated by an AI image engine, in one of several styles or with your own prompt. Playlists that get no generated cover, or are still waiting for one, get the fallback template.

fallback_template.label: Fallback template
fallback_template.description: The collage for playlists that get no AI generated cover, and for any playlist until its generated cover is ready.

ai_image_engine.label: Image engine
ai_image_engine.description: The engine that draws the covers, for example a Home Assistant AI Task entity that supports images or an image model of the OpenAI Compatible plugin (such as OpenRouter).

ai_style.label: Style
ai_style.description: The look of the generated covers.

option_descriptions.music_assistant: A vibrant gradient in colors that match the playlist's mood, with a large white line-art illustration of its theme in the style of the Music Assistant app's icons and a bold white title.
option_descriptions.neon: The playlist's scene drawn in glowing neon lines on a dark background, in Music Assistant blue with one accent color, with a white neon title.
option_descriptions.bold: One striking full-bleed image with a vivid duotone or saturated color wash and a large, bold title.
option_descriptions.soft_gradient: A soft, blurred, vivid mesh gradient with a small white title in the bottom-left corner.
option_descriptions.risograph: A two-color screen print illustration on off-white paper, with halftone dots and grain and a chunky printed title.
option_descriptions.gouache: A warm, painted magazine-style illustration of the playlist's scene, with a clean title at the top.

ai_custom_prompt.label: Custom prompt
ai_custom_prompt.description: The prompt sent to the image engine. You can use {name} or {title} (the playlist name), {context} (the seeds, era, artists and genres as sentences), {concept} (the visual concept), {artists}, {genres} and {era}.

ai_title_overlay.label: Let Music Assistant add the playlist name
ai_title_overlay.description: Off: the image engine designs the playlist name into the artwork. This looks the most natural, but some engines misspell it. On: the image engine makes artwork without any text and Music Assistant prints the playlist name on top, so it is always spelled correctly.

skip_provider_playlists.label: Skip provider playlists
skip_provider_playlists.description: When enabled, provider playlists that already have their own cover are skipped. When disabled, they keep their own cover and also receive a generated collage as a background image. Playlists without a cover always receive a generated collage.

enable_genre_detection.label: Enable genre detection
enable_genre_detection.description: Automatically detect and assign genres based on track metadata.

genre_min_threshold.label: Genre minimum threshold (%)
genre_min_threshold.description: Minimum percentage of tracks that must have a genre for it to be included.

genre_max_count.label: Maximum number of genres
genre_max_count.description: Maximum number of genres to assign to a playlist.

ai_preview_playlist.label: Preview playlist
ai_preview_playlist.description: The playlist to make a preview cover for.

ai_preview_style.label: Styles to preview
ai_preview_style.description: The styles to try, shown side by side. Each style is one image generation.

ai_preview_custom_prompt.label: Custom prompt to preview
ai_preview_custom_prompt.description: The prompt used when Custom is one of the styles to preview. You can use the same placeholders as the custom prompt.

ai_preview.label: Preview cover
ai_preview.description: Generate a cover for the chosen playlist in each style to preview, and the description the text engine would write for it. They are only shown here and do not change your settings or the playlist.

ai_descriptions.label: Write descriptions with AI
ai_descriptions.description: Give the playlists for AI a short, editorial-style description written by the text engine, inspired by what you play most. It is written once per playlist and put back whenever it gets replaced.

ai_playlists.label: Playlists for AI
ai_playlists.description: Which playlists get an AI generated cover and description. The others get the fallback template.

options.smart: Smart playlists, plus the ones I pick

ai_extra_playlists.label: Also use AI for
ai_extra_playlists.description: Regular playlists that get an AI generated cover and description as well. Smart playlists are always included.

ai_text_engine.label: Text engine
ai_text_engine.description: The AI engine that writes the descriptions and, when enabled, the visual concept of the covers.

ai_use_prompt_engine.label: Let the text engine write the visual concept
ai_use_prompt_engine.description: Have the text engine turn the playlist's name, seeds, artists and genres into a scene description before the image is drawn. This costs an extra AI request per cover.

ai_max_per_hour.label: Maximum generations per hour
ai_max_per_hour.description: The number of covers, and separately of descriptions, generated per hour. The rest follow in the next hour, to keep the cost of the AI engines under control.

ai_regenerate.label: Regenerate everything
ai_regenerate.description: Generate new AI covers and descriptions for all playlists. The current ones stay in place until their replacement is ready.
